name: sram_mbist_demo_controller
description: Synthesizable 256x32 memory model used only as a fallback when the prebuilt Sky130 SRAM collateral is unavailable. It preserves the same functional wrapper interface so AutoMBIST and synthesis flows can replace or wrap it later.
functionality: Implements a simple synchronous scratchpad memory with 256 words of 32 bits. A low csb enables access, web selects write versus read, and dout returns the addressed word on read access. The model is synthesizable and uses only generic RTL constructs. It exists to keep the interface stable for demonstration, simulation, and synthesis fallback purposes.
responsibilities: Serve as the fallback implementation for the SRAM wrapper.
Maintain synthesis-friendly behavior with no vendor primitives.
Match the wrapper port list exactly.
reset_behavior: On reset or power-up simulation, memory contents may be unspecified unless explicitly initialized for test; functional interface behavior remains deterministic for control signals.
behavior_rules: Must preserve the exact wrapper interface for replacement by macro collateral.
Must remain compatible with downstream MBIST collateral generation and wrapping.
